body.statement: With \(M_4=2\) and \(\epsilon=1/100\), the baseline triangular array \(W_{\mathrm{mix}}\) belongs to \(\mathcal M\), and \(\mathsf P_n^{h,\rho}\) is its chronological local-alternative law. Its bounded symmetric supports give the empirical centered fourth-moment inequality in \(\mathrm{ass{:}bounded\mbox{-}fourth\mbox{-}moments}\). Substitution of its deterministic quantiles into the exact formulas for \(X\), \(R_1\), and \(R_2\) gives, for both active pairs \(j=((1,1),s)\), \(A_s=200\sqrt5/(53\sqrt{203})\), \(b_{1j}=8/5\), \(b_{2j}=43/100\), and \(\kappa_j=1393\sqrt5/(250\sqrt{203})\), with the certified enclosures in \(\mathrm{def{:}negative\mbox{-}mixture\mbox{-}witness}\) and \(\Delta_j\in[-0.80693126929013,-0.80693126929009]\). Uniformly over \(\rho\in I\) and \(h\in H\), the sampling probability of \(E_{n,(1,1)}(\rho)\) has limit inferior at least \(Q(-113/100)^2\in[0.75822626517532,0.75822626517534]\). Moreover, for every \(\delta>0\), \(\sup_{\rho\in I,h\in H}\mathsf P_n^{h,\rho}\{\lvert p_{\mathrm{ref}}(n,(1,1),\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)-Q(-113/100)^2\rvert>\delta\}\to0\). Thus \(W_{\mathrm{mix}}\) satisfies both the deterministic sampling margin and the random-reference margin.
body.justification: This verifies joint finite-population realizability and exposes every numerical ingredient used by the interior certificate.
body.gap: Gaussian-coordinate counterexamples alone need not correspond to any randomized finite population; this proposition realizes the signed regime with exact bounded distributions and certified primitive boxes.
body.consumer: A referee can reproduce the negative-discrepancy example from its mixture weights, supports, allocation, and exact radical primitives.
